name: maxx-picorom-carrier
description: Preliminary tscircuit schematic for a Maxx Steele cartridge built around an upstream PicoROM-32 module.

scripts.check: tsci check source picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx && tsci check netlist picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx && tsci check pin_specification picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx && tsci check schematic-placement picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx && tsci check placement picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx
scripts.export: tsci export picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx -f circuit-json -o ../render/picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.json && tsci export picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx -f readable-netlist -o ../render/picorom-p32-carrier.net.txt && tsci export picorom-p32-carrier.circuit.tsx -f schematic-svg -o ../render/picorom-p32-carrier-schematic.svg
